overview: Non-negative weights ke liye single-source shortest path; greedy, priority queue.
coreConcept: Non-negative weights ke liye single-source shortest path; greedy, priority queue.
hinglishExplanation: Har step par sabse chhoti tentative distance wala vertex finalize karo aur uske neighbours relax karo.
formalDefinition: Non-negative weights ke liye single-source shortest path; greedy, priority queue.
importantProperties: O(V^2) array, O((V+E) log V) binary heap, O(E + V log V) Fibonacci heap.
Negative edges par fail hota hai.
Unweighted graph par BFS queue linear time deti hai.
Undirected positive weights par bhi chalta hai.
